company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
The Center for a New American Security is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC, with its website at cnas.org. It describes itself as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

Its site addresses artificial intelligence directly, noting that AI systems continue to progress at a steady pace, a trend it says has fed forecasts about artificial general intelligence. Earlier this year the organization launched the Sovereign AI Index, which it describes as tracking every government-backed sovereign AI project since 2023, projects that seek to improve a country's AI self-reliance.

No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for the organization, and its law exposure is recorded in Washington with a count of 114.
